items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: Buddy did? Buddy petite? Yeah. Oh, with Thomas? Yeah, he played over there and he'd play second.

ctx.x: Well, you say he played second trumpet. Did he ever have another trumpet in the band with him?

Well, not when he'd have his own band, uh, he was traveling and he didn't have no other trumpet. But when he'd go play with other bands, like Kid Thomas sometimes, now he played with us over the river a long time. Oh, Buddy did? Buddy petite? Yeah. Oh, with Thomas? Yeah, he played over there and he'd play second.
